descrizione: messy dark hair, energetic dark eyes with thick eyebrows, confident half-smile, small scar across right cheek, big head about 45 % of height on a short cartoon body, light tan skin, unbuttoned cream-white short-sleeve shirt over a coral undershirt, rolled deep-teal shorts, brick-red sneakers with cream soles
carattere: A spirited, naive young man of about 20 with a big heart and high energy, carrying a small cheek scar showing he has already survived tough adventures and knows how to manage.

mosse.cammina: WALK CYCLE, 4 frames: right foot forward contact, passing pose with the legs together, left foot forward contact, passing pose with the legs together, arms swinging opposite to the legs (frame 2 is also the standing pose)
mosse.scatto: DASH WITH A ROLL, 4 frames, drawn with the classic animation principles: 1) ANTICIPATION: a deep crouch, the body squashed low and compact, leaning back, both arms swung back, the hair dropping; 2) EXPLOSIVE LUNGE: the body STRETCHED long and low in a diving arc toward the front (thinner and longer, the same volume), arms and legs reaching, the hair streaming backward; 3) TUMBLE: tucked into a tight round ball (squashed, compact) rolling forward along the same arc; 4) LANDING back on his feet in a low running pose, the knees bent absorbing the impact, one arm swinging forward, the hair still swinging down and forward a moment after the body (follow-through)
mosse.bevi: DRINKING A POTION, 4 frames: 1) holding a small round glass potion bottle with glowing mint liquid at chest height, his eyes on it, the knees dipping a little (anticipation); 2) raising it to his mouth, the elbow leading in a smooth arc; 3) drinking with the head tilted back and the eyes closed, the free arm relaxed, the hair falling back; 4) lowering the bottle with a satisfied grin, the shoulders relaxed, the hair and the shirt settling a moment after the movement (follow-through). The bottle keeps exactly the same shape and size in every frame
mosse.leggera: WALK CYCLE CARRYING A ONE-HANDED WEAPON, 4 frames: exactly the same walking legs as the walk of the last attached sheet (right foot forward contact, passing pose with the legs together, left foot forward contact, passing pose with the legs together), the left arm swinging, while his RIGHT fist holds a straight rigid cyan rod like the hilt of a sword: 2 pixels thick, about as long as his legs, it starts inside his right fist and points forward and DOWN at about 45 degrees, nothing of it sticks out on the other side of the fist; the right arm hangs relaxed and keeps the rod steady. The rod is bright pure cyan #00FFFF, always at least 2 full pixels thick along its whole length, drawn on top of everything and clearly visible from every angle, never thinner and never hidden behind the body or the outline.
mosse.pesante: WALK CYCLE CARRYING A HEAVY TWO-HANDED WEAPON ON THE SHOULDER, 4 frames: the same walking legs as row 1, while BOTH fists, close together in front of his chest, hold the LOWER end of a straight rigid cyan rod 2 pixels thick and about as long as his whole body; the rod rests on his RIGHT shoulder and points UP and BACKWARD past his head; the arms stay still holding it while the legs walk.
mosse.onda: ENERGY WAVE ATTACK like a famous anime energy blast, 4 frames: 1) feet wide apart in a low stance, both hands cupped together at his right hip with a small solid cyan ball (about 4 pixels) between the palms; 2) deeper crouch, body twisted back, hair blown upward by the power, the cyan ball between the cupped hands bigger (about 7 pixels); 3) thrusting both arms straight forward, palms open and pushed together, the cyan ball (about 7 pixels) right at the palms; 4) holding the push leaning forward, front knee bent, the cyan ball at the palms. Only the ball, no beam, no rays, no sparks: the effect is added later. EXAGGERATE the effort like an anime hero: the stance deeper and the push bigger than realistic; in frames 3 and 4 the hair and the shirt are blown backward by the blast (follow-through)
mosse.passo1: PROFESSIONAL WALK CYCLE, FIRST STEP, 4 frames that continue into the next row, a relaxed natural walk with a clear up-and-down bounce: 1) CONTACT: the RIGHT leg reaches forward straight with only the HEEL touching the ground and the toes lifted, the other leg straight behind pushing on its toes, the legs at their widest, the arm opposite to the front leg swung forward and the other arm swung back; 2) DOWN, the LOWEST pose: the front foot now flat on the ground taking the weight with that knee bent, the whole body and the head about 2 pixels LOWER than in frame 1, the back foot peeling off the ground, the arms at their widest swing; 3) PASSING: the supporting leg straight under the body, the other leg bent at the knee with its foot lifted and passing beside the supporting ankle, the arms passing close to the body; 4) UP, the HIGHEST pose: rising on the toes of the supporting leg, now a little behind, the body and the head about 2 pixels HIGHER than in frame 1, the free leg swinging forward and reaching out for the next step, the arms swinging the other way. ARMS, very important: a BIG clearly readable arm swing opposite to the legs, both arms always visible OUTSIDE the torso silhouette and never hidden behind the body, the forward hand well in front of the body and the back hand well behind it at the widest poses (in front and back views the two hands show at the two sides of the body, one swung forward and up, the other swung back), the arms passing beside the hips in the passing pose, the arm positions changing smoothly from frame to frame
mosse.passo2: PROFESSIONAL WALK CYCLE, SECOND STEP: the same 4 poses as the row above with the legs and the arms swapped, 4 frames, after frame 4 the cycle loops back to frame 1 of the row above, a relaxed natural walk with a clear up-and-down bounce: 1) CONTACT: now the LEFT leg reaches forward straight with only the HEEL touching the ground and the toes lifted, the other leg straight behind pushing on its toes, the legs at their widest, the arm opposite to the front leg swung forward and the other arm swung back; 2) DOWN, the LOWEST pose: the front foot now flat on the ground taking the weight with that knee bent, the whole body and the head about 2 pixels LOWER than in frame 1, the back foot peeling off the ground, the arms at their widest swing; 3) PASSING: the supporting leg straight under the body, the other leg bent at the knee with its foot lifted and passing beside the supporting ankle, the arms passing close to the body; 4) UP, the HIGHEST pose: rising on the toes of the supporting leg, now a little behind, the body and the head about 2 pixels HIGHER than in frame 1, the free leg swinging forward and reaching out for the next step, the arms swinging the other way. ARMS, very important: a BIG clearly readable arm swing opposite to the legs, both arms always visible OUTSIDE the torso silhouette and never hidden behind the body, the forward hand well in front of the body and the back hand well behind it at the widest poses (in front and back views the two hands show at the two sides of the body, one swung forward and up, the other swung back), the arms passing beside the hips in the passing pose, the arm positions changing smoothly from frame to frame
mosse.corsa1: PROFESSIONAL RUN CYCLE, FIRST STEP, 4 frames that continue into the next row, a fast energetic run: the body leaning FORWARD about 15 degrees in every frame, elbows bent at 90 degrees and the arms pumping hard opposite to the legs, a focused face: 1) CONTACT: the RIGHT leg lands with the foot under the knee just ahead of the hips, the other leg trailing behind; 2) DOWN, the LOWEST pose: the landing knee bends deeply absorbing the weight, the body and the head about 3 pixels LOWER than in frame 1, the back leg folding with its heel kicking up high toward the buttocks; 3) PASSING: the supporting leg under the body, the other knee driving forward past it with the foot tucked high under the buttocks, the arms passing beside the body; 4) PUSH-OFF AND FLIGHT, the HIGHEST pose: the back leg fully stretched after pushing off its toes, the front knee raised high, BOTH FEET OFF THE GROUND, this frame drawn clearly higher in its cell (the lowest foot about 4 pixels above the baseline), the arms at their widest swing. ARMS, very important: a BIG clearly readable arm swing opposite to the legs, both arms always visible OUTSIDE the torso silhouette and never hidden behind the body, the forward hand well in front of the body and the back hand well behind it at the widest poses (in front and back views the two hands show at the two sides of the body, one swung forward and up, the other swung back), the arms passing beside the hips in the passing pose, the arm positions changing smoothly from frame to frame
mosse.corsa2: PROFESSIONAL RUN CYCLE, SECOND STEP: the same 4 poses as the row above with the legs and the arms swapped, 4 frames, after frame 4 the cycle loops back to frame 1 of the row above, a fast energetic run: the body leaning FORWARD about 15 degrees in every frame, elbows bent at 90 degrees and the arms pumping hard opposite to the legs, a focused face: 1) CONTACT: now the LEFT leg lands with the foot under the knee just ahead of the hips, the other leg trailing behind; 2) DOWN, the LOWEST pose: the landing knee bends deeply absorbing the weight, the body and the head about 3 pixels LOWER than in frame 1, the back leg folding with its heel kicking up high toward the buttocks; 3) PASSING: the supporting leg under the body, the other knee driving forward past it with the foot tucked high under the buttocks, the arms passing beside the body; 4) PUSH-OFF AND FLIGHT, the HIGHEST pose: the back leg fully stretched after pushing off its toes, the front knee raised high, BOTH FEET OFF THE GROUND, this frame drawn clearly higher in its cell (the lowest foot about 4 pixels above the baseline), the arms at their widest swing. nota: Il protagonista di MAREA (Quest 1), fatto da Riccardo col suo Claude e approvato da Jack, Riccardo e Alberto il 30/10/2026 (3 su 3). 360 sprite in 9 viste, 48 px, 20 colori: camminata (4 disegni), scatto, bevi, leggera, pesante, onda, e le 8 pose di camminata e corsa (camminata_1-8, corsa_1-8, come F3).
